title: Microsoft offers mass buyouts for roughly a quarter of its workforce
why_read: A large corporate workforce restructuring at Microsoft is relevant to engineers' career planning even though it's a business story rather than a technical one.
analysis: This concerns Microsoft offering buyouts to a large fraction of its staff, a significant corporate HR and financial maneuver rather than a technical development. It matters to engineers mainly as an indicator of industry-wide restructuring possibly tied to AI-driven automation of software work or cost-cutting. There's no technical content to evaluate here, just a business/labor market signal with high reader interest due to personal career relevance.
